facts: Sunstone Savages payouts varied: 50 coins documented in 2007 and 2012, 25 in 2008, and 150 in 2008. Popularity scaling is a player explanation; its exact formula remains unrecovered.
Admission requires three to six group members. Kill 25 Sunstone goblins, King Vigdos and the Sunstone High Priest, then report to Daemon. A 2008 comment records no respawns.
The chain advances to Altar Call; a September 2008 comment says the first task repeats only after the whole chain.
The first Mer mission rewards 40 Doubloons and faction. A February 2007 correction says these rewards are combined, rather than exclusive choices.

Original steps: receive a Pirate Seal, deliver it to Jor, buy the Maiden's Grave ticket and board the appropriate ship, loot four Wreckage pieces from the inner siren cluster, and deliver them to Mer.
Three group members and an average level of 70 are documented, with a six-hour duration. July 2009 repeatability reports support two runs for 80 coins.
A September 2008 post gives Y 2714, X 3966, Z 306 for the wreckage area.
Bone Joint Compound costs 10 Doubloons at Indifferent faction, supported by the March 2007 stock list and a 2012 confirmation.
Every existing native stock slot now has a researched price: 104 match the current primary table; the remaining two are found in original 2007 posts.
A March 2013 post reports that the Cloudy Energeian Light Orb is absent. Do not import items merely because the current table lists them.
